title: Text Stroke Generator
description: Style outlined text with -webkit-text-stroke — width, stroke and fill colors, live preview and CSS.
howto: Type your text and set the font size.
Choose stroke width, stroke color and fill color (or transparent fill).
Copy the CSS or download it as text-stroke.css.

faqs.q: Does text-stroke work in all browsers?
faqs.a: -webkit-text-stroke works in Chrome, Edge, Safari, Firefox and Opera. The generator also sets paint-order for cleaner edges.
The letters become hollow outlines — only the stroke is visible.

faqs.q: Can I use a custom font?
faqs.a: Yes — add your own font-family to the rule after copying it.

faqs.q: Why does the preview differ from my site?
faqs.a: Stroke rendering follows the font in use; the CSS values stay identical across fonts.
